label: ARMS
title: A staff portal for our client, Agape Academy International School.
intro: ARMS is a client project: the secure staff system ZIIV designed and built for Agape Academy International School, in the school’s own colours and installable on any phone or computer.

modules.label: What we built
modules.title: Secure access for every member of staff.

items.name: Staff sign-in
items.text: Staff sign in with their staff ID or email, with password recovery when they need it.

items.name: Account requests
items.text: New teachers request an account themselves instead of being set up by hand.

items.name: Installable app
items.text: ARMS installs from the browser and opens full screen from a phone or desktop home screen.

items.name: School branding
items.text: Designed around Agape Academy’s crest, colours and pattern, so it feels like the school’s own.

signin.label: Designed for the school
signin.title: It looks and feels like Agape Academy.
signin.text: The crest, the motto and the school’s purple run through every screen, with a pattern drawn from its identity.
points: A prompt to install the app

anywhere.label: Phone and desktop
anywhere.title: In every teacher’s pocket.
anywhere.text: Teachers can install ARMS on their phones and open it like any other app, while office staff use it from a computer.

cta.title: Need a system like this for your school?
cta.text: Tell us how your school runs and we’ll design a staff system around it, in your own colours.
